verses: Haa Meem
Yeh kitab Allah ghalib hikmat walay ki taraf say nazil ki hui hai
Aasmano aur zamin mein eman daron kay liye yaqeenan boht si nishaniyan hain
Aur khud tumhari pedaeesh mein aur unn janwaron ki pedaeesh mein jinhen woh phelata hai yaqeen rakhney wali qom kay liye boht si nishaniyan hain

Aur raat din kay badalney mein aur jo kuch rozi Allah Taalaa aasman say nazil farma ker zamin ko uss ki maut kay baad zindah ker deta hai, (uss mein) aur hawaon kay badalney mein bhi unn logon kay liye jo aqal rakhtay hain nishaniyan hain
Yeh hain Allah ki aayaten jinhen hum aap ko raasti say suna rahey hain, pus Allah Taalaa aur uss ki aayaton kay baad yeh kiss baat per eman layen gay
Well aur afsos hai her aik jhootay gunehgar per
Jo aayaten Allah ki apney samney parhi jati hui sunay phir bhi ghuroor kerta hua uss tarah ura rahey kay goya suni hi nahi, to aisay logon ko dard-naak azab ki khabar (phoncha) dijiye
Woh jab humari aayaton mein say kissi aayat ki khabar leta hai to uss ki hansi urata hai, yehi log hain jin kay liye ruswaee ki maar hai

Unn kay peechay dozakh hai, jo kuch unhon ney hasil kiya tha woh unhen kuch bhi nafa na dey ga aur na woh (kuch kaam aayen gay) jin ko unhon ney Allah kay siwa kaarsaaz bana rakha tha, unn kay liye to boht bara azab hai
Yeh (sir tapa) hidayat hai aur jin logon ney apney rab ki aayaton ko na mana unn kay liye boht sakht dard-naak azab hai
Allah hi hai jiss ney tumharay liye darya ko tabey banadiya takay uss kay hukum say uss mein kashtiyan chalen aur tum uss ka fazal talash kero aur takay tum shukar baja
Aur aasman o zamin ki her her cheez ko bhi uss ney apni taraf say tumharay liye tabey ker diya hai. Jo ghor keren yaqeenan woh uss mein boht si nishaniyan paalen gay
Aap eman walon say keh den kay woh unn logon say darguzar keren jo Allah kay dino ki tawaqqa nahi rakhtay, takay Allah Taalaa aik qom ko unn kay kartooton ka badla dey
Jo neki keray ga woh apney zatti bhalay kay liye aur jo buraee keray ga uss ka wabaal ussi per hai, phir tum sab apney perwerdigar ki taraf lotaye jao gay
Yaqeenan hum ney bani israeel ko kitab, hukoomat aur naboowat di thi, aur hum ney unhen pakeezah (aur nafees) roziyan di thin aur unhen duniya walon per fazilat di thi

Aur hum ney unhen deen ki saaf saaf daleelen den, phir unhon ney apney pass ilm kay phonch janey kay baad aapas ki zidd behas say hi ikhtilaf barpa ker dala, yeh jin jin cheezon mein ikhtilaf ker rahey hain unn ka faisla qayamat walay din unn kay darmiyan (khud) tera rab keray ga
Phir hum ney aap ko deen ki (zahir) raah per qaeem kerdiya, so aap ussi per lagay rahen aur nadanon ki khuwaishon ki pairwee mein na paren
(yaad rakhen) kay yeh log hergiz Allah kay samney aap kay kuch kaam nahi saktay. (samajh len kay) zalim log aapas mein aik doosray kay rafiq hotay hain aur perhezgaron ka kaarsaaz Allah Taalaa hai
Yeh (Quran) logon kay liye baseerat ki baaten aur hidayat o rehmat hai uss qom kay liye jo yaqeen rakhti hai

Kiya unn logon ka jo buray kaam kertay hain yeh guman hai kay hum unhen unn logon jaisa ker den gay jo eman laye aur nek kaam kiye kay unn ka marna jeena yaksan hojaye, bura hai woh faisla jo woh rahey hain
Aur aasmano aur zamin ko Allah ney boht hi adal kay sath peda kiya hai aur takay her shakhs ko uss kay kiye huye kaam ka poora badla diya jaye aur unn per zulm na kiya jaye ga

Kiya aap ney ussay bhi dekha? Jiss ney apni khuwahish nafs ko apna mabood bana rakha hai aur bawajood samajh bojh kay Allah ney ussay gumrah kerdiya hai aur uss kay kaan aur dil per mehar laga hai aur uss ki aankh per bhi pardah daal diya hai, abb aisay shakhs ko Allah kay baad kaun hidayat dey sakta hai

Kiya abb bhi tum naseehat nahi pakartay. Unhon ney kaha kay humari zindagi to sirf duniya ki zindagi hi hai. Hum martay hain aur jeetay hain aur humen sirf zamaney hi maar dalta hai, (dar-asal) unhen uss ka kuch ilm hi nahi. Yeh to sirf (qayas aur) atkal say hi kaam ley rahey hain
Aur jab unn kay samney humari wazeh aur roshan aayaton ki tilawat ki jati hai, to unn kay pass uss qol kay siwa koi daleel nahi hoti kay agar tum sachay ho to humaray baap dadon ko lao
Aap keh dijiye! Allah hi tumhen zindah kerta hai phir tumhen maar dalta hai phir tumhen qayamat kay din jama keray ga jiss mein koi shak nahi lekin aksar log nahi samajhtay
Aur aasmano aur zamin ki badshahi Allah hi ki hai aur jiss din qayamat qaeem hogi uss din ahl baatil baray nuksan mein paren gay
Aur aap dekhen gay kay her ummat ghutno kay bal giri hui hogi. Her giroh apney nama aemaal ki taraf bulaya jaye ga, aaj tumhen apney kiye ka badla diya jaye ga
Yeh hai humari kitab jo tumharay baray mein sach sach bol rahi hai, hum tumharay aemaal likhwatay jatay thay
Pus lekin jo log eman laye aur unhon ney nek kaam kiye to unn ko unn ka rab apni rehmat talay ley ley ga, yehi sareeh kaamyabi hai
Lekin jin logon ney kufur kiya to (mein unn say kahon ga) kiya meri aayaten tumhen sunaee nahi jati thin? Phir bhi tum takabbur kertay rahey aur tum thay hi gunehgar gaar log

Aur jab kabhi kaha jata kay Allah ka wada yaqeenan sacha hai aur qayamat kay aaney mein koi shak nahi to tum jawab detay thay kay hum nahi jantay qayamat kiya cheez hai? Humen kuch yun hi sa khayal hojata hai lekin humen yaqeen nahi
Aur unn per apney aemaal ki buraiyan khul gaeen aur jiss ka woh mazaq ura rahey thay uss ney unhen gher liya
Aur keh diya gaya kay aaj hum tumhen bhala den gay jaisay kay tum ney apney uss din say milney ko bhala diya tha tumhara thikana jahannum hai aur tumhara madadgar koi nahi

Yeh uss liye hai kay tum ney Allah Taalaa ki aayaton ki hansi uraee thi aur duniya ki zindagi ney tumhen dhokay mein daal rakha tha, pus aaj kay din na to yeh (dozakh) say nikalay jayen gay aur na unn say uzur o maazrat qabool kiya jaye ga
Pus Allah ki tareef hai jo aasmano aur zamin aur tamam jahaan ka palanhaar hai
Tamam (buzrugi aur) baraee aasmano aur zamin mein ussi ki hai aur o hi ghalib aur hikmat wala hai
